name: Opening Laptop
description: A laptop drawn in CSS whose lid opens as you scroll, until the picture on its screen lifts out and grows over the keyboard.

props.name: src
props.description: The picture on the screen. A wide image of about 5:3 fills it without cropping much.

props.name: alt
props.description: Text alternative for the screen picture.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading above the laptop. It fades as the lid opens; bring your own heading element.

props.name: badge
props.description: A small mark that sits on the front left corner of the deck.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the outer element, which is two and a half screens tall so there is room to scroll.
